en.text: The generation of 2126. Care on the Jegi-dong (Gyeongdong) herbal medicine market side. She had no martial path. The hand was medicine. The herbal ledger of Jegi-dong and the hospital duty line left a care contract that did not separate friend from foe. Ryu Eunbi became Board Chair after keeping the sickbed ledger of the Cheongnyangni Medical House in an unbroken line. The ledger of the Jegi-dong Healing Gate belonged to Jeong Harin. The night workshops of Dongdaemun were an enclave in the west of this state. When counterfeit medicine circulated, she cut the trade. She read severity and public contribution together. If Nam Yungyeong's market prices bought up the medicine first, the sickbeds emptied.
Rank: Board Chair. Title: Board Chair of the White Cross. Livelihood byname: Head of the Healing Guild.
None. Only a livelihood. The hand remained medicine.
On the day the counterfeit box went to auction, Ryu Eunbi cut the trade before O Haerin's seal. The cut fell on the same day as Jeong Hojun's specimen seal.
Cheongnyangni Medical House (HP03). Steward. The steward of the Jegi-dong Healing Gate (HP06) was Jeong Harin.
The specimen with Jeong Hojun. Medicine prices with Nam Yungyeong.

ko.text: 2126년 세대. 제기동 약재시장(경동) 쪽 치료. 무공은 없다. 손은 약이다. 제기동 약령 장부와 병원 당직이 적과 아군을 가리지 않는 치료 서약을 남겼다. 단장은 전문의의 임상 판단을 감독하고 전문의가 지정한 수련의의 승계를 확인한다. 류은비가 단장이 된 것은 청량리의료원가의 침상 명부를 끊기지 않게 지킨 뒤였다. 제기동치유문의 명부는 정하린의 것이다. 동대문 야간 공임은 이 나라 서쪽 호다. 가짜 약이 돌면 거래를 끊는다. 중증도와 진료 소견을 같이 본다. 남윤경의 시세가 약을 선매하면 침상이 빈다.
품계 단장. 직함은 흰십자단 단장. 생업 별명은 의료단 단장.
가짜 약 상자가 경매에 오른 날, 류은비는 오해린의 봉인 전에 거래를 끊었다. 끊김이 정호준의 표본 봉인과 같은 날이었다.

text.en: The powers who moved the Jegi-dong market and the Cheongnyangni care network through the patients' council's work.

text.en: Quiet of voice, he did not step back at a vote. He liked to recast the guild's charity as a right.

en.text: In 2125, short of herbs, he halved the prescriptions and divided them among everyone. By this deed the signature of the patients' council representative post rose into the ledger.

ko.text: 2125년 약재 부족으로 처방량을 반으로 나눠 모두에게 나눴다. 이 일로 중증도 진료 전문의 자리의 서명이 장부에 올랐다.

en.text: Shared the vote with Ryu Eunbi, watched Sim Dalho's pre-buying, and promised Baek On the Bukhansan Bogukmun sickbed allocation.

ko.text: 류은비와 표결을 공유하고, 심달호의 선매를 감시하며, 백온에게 북한산보국문 병상 할당을 약속했다.

en.text: Kept the patient representative's veto as an equal-clause for guild and merchant alike, and blocked the secret pacts that pushed out the wounded of great powers.

ko.text: 담당 전문의의 진료 거부권을 중증도 우선 원칙으로 남겨 강국 부상자를 밀어내는 밀약을 막는다.

en.text: That he would be branded a great power's puppet patient and expelled from the council.

ko.text: 자신이 강국의 꼭두각시 환자로 낙인찍혀 의료 지휘부에서 축출되는 것.

en.text: Rank: supervisor. Title: Cheongnyangni Station concourse outpost chief. She published the concourse medical waiting lists and the herb unloading order daily and coupled munitions cars to the platform only after the medical convoy had left.

en.text: In the week the pre-buying ledger vanished, a box stamped with a munitions clause stood wedged into the Cheongnyangni concourse waiting list.

ko.text: 선매 장부가 사라진 주, 청량리 대합실 대기표에 군수 문장 상자가 한 줄 끼어 있었다.

en.text: Received Nam Hoseong's convoy stops at the platform and split the queue with Dong Juha's market unloading. Put Jang Sehwa's medical convoy hours at the top of the chalkboard.

en.text: That the summer counterfeit-drug rumor alone would blockade the concourse and scatter the patients into back-gate handcars.

en.text: When the summer counterfeit drugs flowed toward Bukhansan Bogukmun, the herb quarter sealed itself and the pre-buying ledger and the scales' seal vanished together.
